Name: (CP) Transparent Tilled Soil
Author: Ignifex
Description:
If you have a grassy farm but the tilling ruins the grass, this mod lets you still see the map tiles underneath the crops. 

This mod slightly makes the map tiles darker but still transparent, so that you can still see whether the tile is tilled or watered. (Note: might make you squint [i]really[/i] hard)



[size=3][b][u]As of version 1.1.0:[/u][/b][/size]

New configs have been added to the mod! It is recommended that you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for this. Details are as follows:

1. [b]All Locations[/b]: Enables the tilled soil transparency on all locations in the game. 

2. [b]Outdoors Only[/b]: Enables the tilled soil transparency only in outdoor locations.

3. [b]Indoors Only[/b]: Enables the tilled soil transparency only in indoor locations.

4. [b]Custom Locations[/b]: Lets you define which location/s you want to enable the tilled soil transparency using the location's [i]LocationName[/i] or [i]LocationUniqueName[/i], which could be found via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]. You can separate multiple locations with a comma(,). 

Note: ([b]All Locations[/b], [b]Outdoors Only[/b], and [b]Indoors Only[/b] configs cannot be turned on simultaneously. Only one can be applied at a time.)

5. [b]Transparency Percentage[/b]: Lets you choose the degree of transparency of the tilled soil in values of 10s (0-100%).


How to install:
1. Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip this mod to your mods folder.
3. Enjoy!
